items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: we used to see every week Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Yes, she played over that. Occasionally, maybe once a month or so, go over and rest them up, peace, a tune. Can I sit in? Yes, sure. But I tell you, we used to see every week Benny Goodman. Every week, asking Joe, could he sit in at 35th and Calumet. Right around the corner, yes.
Oh yes, the Sunset, was that, or the Plantation? Plantation, that was it.
